name: What is the 180-day exchange period for a 1031 exchange?

mainEntity.name: What is the 180-day exchange period for a 1031 exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 180-day exchange period is the maximum time allowed to close on one or more of your identified replacement properties. This 180-day period runs concurrently with the 45-day identification period and begins on the day you close on your relinquished property. Both deadlines are critical for a successful exchange. If the 180th day falls on a weekend or holiday, the deadline is not extended to the next business day. You'll need to secure financing and complete all closing procedures within this timeframe.
acceptedAnswer.description: The 180-day exchange period is the deadline to close on your replacement property, starting from the sale of your relinquished property and running concurrently with the 45-day identification period.
